Subject: DPA execution sequencing and evidence escrow

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Legal and procurement at FinEdge reviewed the DPA you sent and have a couple of operational asks before we sign:

- We need clarity on signature sequencing (FinEdge signs first vs. Redwood signs first) for our internal control records.
- For SCCs we have a centralized evidence repository requirement — would Redwood be able to provide an "evidence escrow" (read-only bundle) after go-live containing the SOC2 artifact list and the SCCs appendix we will attach to the DPA?

I've attached our internal execution checklist for context (FinEdge_Execution_Checklist.xlsx). Gabe (copied) is our outside counsel and will handle redline/legal clarifications.

Can you confirm who at Redwood will be the primary signer and the champion for the evidence bundle? We have a target signature window of 3 business days once routing is agreed.

Thanks,
Alice

Attachment: FinEdge_Execution_Checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, Gabe Owens <gabe.owens@lawfirmwest.com>
Date: Thu, 28 Jun 2028 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: DPA execution sequencing and evidence escrow

Alice — thanks for the note and for flagging the checklist. Looping in legal ops (Laura), sales lead (Rishi) and privacy (Neha) to confirm flows.

Short answers up front:
- Signature sequencing: Redwood typically signs last so the customer has a fully executed document for their records; however we can be flexible if FinEdge requires a different order for internal sign-off.
- Evidence escrow: we can provide a time-limited evidence bundle hosted in a secure, read-only S3 location with ACLed access, audit logs, and a manifest file (CSV). Retention and redaction rules need to be agreed — e.g., SOC2 artifacts are sensitive; we typically provide redacted copies plus an evidence manifest.

Action items for us: Laura, please confirm the redline set we can accept without exec approval and flag any retention/carveouts that must be escalated. Neha, can your team confirm the minimal SOC2 manifest fields FinEdge needs? Rishi, I'll coordinate signature logistics once legal confirms.

I'm attaching our latest redline to speed things up: FinEdge_DPA_redline_v3.pdf.

Proposed routing:
1) FinEdge confirms signer and accepts evidence approach
2) Redwood legal (Laura) accepts non-material redlines; any material carveouts routed to our GC for approval
3) DocuSign envelope generated with signer order (customer signs first, Redwood countersigns within 48 hours)

Target: sign-off by July 5 if routing accepted.

—Markus

Attachment: FinEdge_DPA_redline_v3.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Gabe Owens <gabe.owens@lawfirmwest.com>

Subject: Re: DPA execution sequencing and evidence escrow

Markus — quick legal point from our review: please confirm whether Redwood will be acting as a "processor" or "sub-processor" under the SCCs in the appendix — the contractual position affects which clauses we need to retain versus which we can accept as standard. Also:

- We request the SCCs appendix exported as a machine-readable CSV for our records (see attached template).
- For the evidence bundle: we need the manifest to include artifact name, production date, redaction status, and access log sample (last 30 days).

I'll mark up the redline with two narrow asks (retention carveout + controller-to-processor clause). If those remain unresolved we expect a short escalation to your GC.

Regards,
Gabe

Attachment: SCCs_appendix-FinEdge.csv (text/csv)

From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 29 Jun 2028 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: FinEdge DPA redline commentary

Markus / Rishi — I've reviewed Gabe's markup and our redline. Quick notes:

- Controller vs Processor: Redwood is the processor for the FinEdge flow as currently scoped (we process transaction enrichment per their inbound prompts). We'll accept the processor position and leave the controller responsibilities to FinEdge.
- Retention carveout: their proposed 7-year retention for some artifact types is excessive. Recommend we propose a 2-year retention with the option to extend by written request and with CI approval.
- Evidence escrow: acceptable to provide a read-only S3 bundle and manifest. Operational constraint — we will not include raw access logs that contain PII; we'll provide sampled audit lines and an access log digest instead.

If you want to minimize exec touch, accept our two concessions and ask Gabe to confirm. If FinEdge insists on 7 years or raw logs, escalate to GC (cc: our legal director).

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Sr. Legal Ops Manager | Redwood Inference

From: markus.klein@redwood.ai <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: DPA execution sequencing and evidence escrow

Alice — following internal review, here's an operationally executable plan we can sign up to:

1) Contract position: Redwood will execute as Processor. We'll accept the SCCs appendix with the processor annotations; Gabe's marked CSV is fine.
2) Retention: Redwood will provide evidence with a default 2-year retention. Extension to 7 years can be accommodated only with a written business justification and Redwood GC sign-off.
3) Evidence escrow mechanics: Redwood will generate a read-only S3 evidence bundle after go-live containing:
   - Redacted SOC2 artifacts where applicable
   - SCCs appendix as CSV (attached)
   - evidence_bucket_manifest.csv with artifact name, production date, redaction flag, and access-digest
   - A 30-day sampled access log digest (no raw PII-bearing logs)
4) Signature routing: we propose FinEdge signs first, then Redwood countersigns within 48 hours. We'll send a DocuSign envelope with signer order pre-populated.

I've prepared the DocuSign envelope and attached the redline we will upload: FinEdge_DPA_redline_v3.pdf. DocuSign envelope link: https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC123-REDWOOD-FE

Can you confirm:
- FinEdge signer name and email for the envelope
- Agreement to the 2-year default retention and the read-only S3 bundle with the manifest fields described

If you confirm, we'll generate the envelope today and target countersign by July 3 (we can still meet your July 5 window).

Thanks — Markus
